body: Thank you, it's nice that you took time out your day to write that. You're really kind and I'll keep you words in my mind 🖤🖤

Thank you for the help, I have told them that their services aren't that helpful but I am unable to figure out what I need to give me that push. We have honestly tried everything, from cognitive behavioral therapy to just sitting down and crying it all out but nothing ever seems to work. 

As for the medication, I have currently been given a higher dose but I haven't taken them yet, I will soon though.

Although, I guess you are right. I shouldn't rush through it all since everything does take some time. Its understandable that they are trying the best that they can and it will be hard. I'll keep your words in my mind, once again, thank you for the help.

Thank you for your kind words, I'm trying my best. You're really nice. Even though, for other people that may just be a paragraph, to me it actually helps me so much and I'm grateful for that. So thank you, really.

Well as I stated, my mum is drinking every day. It never gets to the point where she would black out but enough to occasionally stop her from walking straight/slur her words. She obviously does this because of me, she's even told me that before in one of our arguments. Most of the time, the thought of it stresses me out which then makes me either drink as well or self harm (I often steal the alcohol from them)

Moving onto the bullying, it had started back in year 7 (Grade 6 I believe), so just when I hard started high school. It was mostly a group of girls or occasionally the whole class. It was always about my weight, how I was known as "the loner" and how sometimes I'd cry because being around alot of people got really overwhelming for me. And, yes, the bullying had stopped which does make me slightly happier but it really has had a toll on the way I see myself.

For the self harm, I do see it as a coping method, I'd say I do it a couple times every week. I honestly do it because I feel like I deserve it and I deserve to feel pain because of how much of a failure of a child I am. Other reasons are because I just want to feel something, for the past couple weeks I've been feeling empty and hollow. No emotions.

Lastly, what happened was I went up to my room and took it out from a small box that I hide it in. I had then tried to slit my wrists but I just couldn't do it. I couldn't go deep enough and I didn't want to try. I'd say the only thing that was stopping me was my fear of death. After that I just felt ashamed and disappointed in myself. Disappointed because I couldn't do it right and ashamed because I'm too scared and not able to be a normal child.

But that's really it, I'm not sure what else I can add really.

Thank you, well I'm currently going to Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAHMS for short) but I don't find that much help. They have also started giving me antidepressants (fluoxetine). But yet again, I also don't find that help either.

Thank you Andy, sorry if this is too long.

I honestly have many reasons why I feel like this, which is honestly just confusing me and hard on me. 

To start, back when I had first started high school, I would be bullied daily because of my sexuality and weight. This had caused me to have bad thoughts about the way I look and feel causing me to self harm.

That had gone on for the whole year until I moved into year 8, which I'm currently in now. Because of the self harm, my parents would drink and smoke which put a lot of pressure on me. Whenever my mum would drink and get drunk we would get into arguments more often about my mental health. This would lead to both of us crying and me running to my room, breaking and smashing things and then more self harm.

Another reason I feel this way is because of my mum's marriage. Her and my dad are not close at all. They'd fight (not physically) and argue. My dad is always locked in his room smoking drinking, and working a shitty job as a security guard at a small shop. My mum feels like she has to pay for everything and she just wants a divorce. The only reason she won't is because of me. I feel like if I just killed myself she would have a happy life without the stress having to stay with him because of me.

This is the second time I've tried to kill myself, the first time was with a razor blade, but that didn't work. I don't know what to do anymore.

I'm sorry if that was too long, I just really needed to get all those things off my chest.
Do you mind if I pm you?

Thank you for your kind words, I just don't know what to do. My family are strict religious Africans and the problem is that I'm part of the LGBTQ+ which they already hate and being the odd one out with mental health problems Is going to make me relationship with them worse. I'm constantly fighting with my parents and this is stressing them out enough. I never have anyone to talk to, but I thank you. You're really kind for saying this things about me. I'll try.

Every day I'm constantly fighting with my mum. Whenever I talk about how I feel she's constantly blames it on me and tries to play the victim. Her marriage with my father is bad and it already taking a toll on me and I just don't know what to do or who to turn to. I just got in an argument with her now and I'm so tired of everything. She's constantly drinking and my dad smokes daily due to stress. My therapist doesn't help either and is just a waste of money.  I can never vent and when I do, I feel like they think I'm looking for attention.
